issues.description: The problem statement and template refer to an interface named 'Rideable', but the solution implementation uses an interface named 'Mountable' (and the solution contains an empty Rideable.java). This naming mismatch for the same concept (an interface with messageOnRide()) is likely unintentional and will confuse students about which interface to implement and which type the provided Main example and UML expect.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the interface name across all artifacts. Rename the solution's Mountable interface (and its usages in Pig and Seal) to Rideable, and implement Rideable.java properly (or remove the empty Rideable.java and replace it with a Rideable interface with String messageOnRide()). Ensure the template, problem statement, and solution all reference the same interface identifier.
